_meta.description: Openconnector source registry for Shillinq. External submission targets referenced by slug; credentials and protocol mapping live in openconnector (ADR-019). Shillinq carries slug references only.

sources.title: Audit portal — accountant
sources.description: Openconnector source row for external submission of audit-pack outputs to the accountant's audit portal. Per-accountant, per-administration: one source row per (accountant × administration) pair. Protocol mapping (endpoint URL, authentication, data format) is openconnector-side per ADR-019. Shillinq references this source by slug when triggering audit-pack exports. REQ-REK-002 / REQ-REK-003 / REQ-REK-004.

auth.description: Credentials, OAuth tokens, and mTLS certificates live exclusively in the openconnector Source record. Shillinq MUST NOT store or log any credential — only this slug reference.

protocol.description: Endpoint URL, HTTP verb, payload format (e.g. NIVRA XML multipart upload, JSON metadata envelope), and retry policy are declared in the openconnector Source record, not here.

usage.description: Shillinq audit-pack aggregations call this source slug to submit the generated docudesk attachment to the external audit portal after the export audit event is recorded.

sources.description_nl: Openconnector bronrij voor het aanleveren van audit-pack outputs aan het accountantsportaal. Per accountant per administratie: één bronrij per combinatie. Protocol-mapping (endpoint-URL, authenticatie, dataformaat) staat in openconnector. Shillinq verwijst uitsluitend via slug.
